problem_statement: Support react-i18next "defaults" prop #### Version - i18next: 11.2.2 - i18next-scanner: 2.4.6 - react-i18next: 7.7.0 #### Configuration ```js options: { // use strings as keys nsSeparator: false, keySeparator: false, // settings defaultNs: "frontend", lngs: ["en"], resource: { loadPath: "{{lng}}/{{ns}}.json", savePath: "{{lng}}/{{ns}}.json", }, func: false, trans: false, defaultValue: (language, namespace, key) => key, }, ``` react-i18n v7.7.0 introduced the `defaults` prop (see i18next/react-i18next#439). I expect the following code: ```jsx foo] /> ``` to lead to the following output: ```json { "Hello <0>{val}!": "Hello <0>{val}!" } ```
